All three exposed development adaptive processes remain invalid; matching raw labels or exact report facts do not repair them.
Historical strict support and status scores can be nonzero in an invalid process.
Fresh source, schemas, prompts, budgets and cases were frozen before inference; no fresh-output tuning.
Reporting contract, exact projection, fixed search and annotation scorer unchanged; richer planning context changes with the planning contract.
New suite uses different propositions and evidence atoms; no cross-suite improvement or model-winner claim.
Citation resolution, field support, and process structure do not prove semantic truth or complete investigation.
